embedContext.description: Metadata prefixed to a chunk's text before embedding (never to the stored or displayed text). A chunk of bare table rows shares no term and no semantic signal with the document it came from, so without this it is unretrievable for a query about that document's subject. CHANGING THIS REQUIRES A RE-INDEX: existing vectors were built from a different string.

promptLocator.description: Metadata shown in a source header in the grounded prompt, so an answer can say where a fact came from. Only keys a chunking strategy actually produces are useful here; an absent key is skipped silently. rowRange comes from TableAwareChunkingStrategy; sheet and page are reserved for structure-aware parsing that does not yet emit them.
